name: benchmark-scidocs
description: A benchmark built around scientific documents to evaluate models' abilities to comprehend, summarize, retrieve information from, and answer questions about scientific texts. It contains scientific documents paired with tasks such as summarization and question-answer pairs to assess document-level understanding and information extraction.
general_score_metric: ROUGE-L (for summarization) / F1 or exact_match (for QA)
reputation: A community-contributed Hugging Face dataset with limited but relevant adoption for scientific-document understanding and summarization research.
